title: PBA: San Miguel keeps semis bid alive, overcomes Ginebra
summary: San Miguel tore down a 17-point deficit to eventually overcome Ginebra, 108-102, in the PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Friday at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.
